name: job-application-autofill
description: Chrome extension to autofill job applications

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && npm run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp content.css dist/ && cp background.js dist/ && node scripts/emit-install-attribution.mjs && mkdir -p dist/icons && (cp -r icons/* dist/icons/ || true)
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/utils/optionMatch.test.ts src/utils/siteRules/greenhouseValues.test.ts src/utils/siteRules/ashbyFields.test.ts src/utils/siteRules/leverFields.test.ts tests/greenhouseFields.test.ts src/utils/ats.test.ts src/utils/fillContract.test.ts src/utils/fillValue.test.ts src/content/fieldMatch.test.ts src/lib/supabaseConfig.test.ts src/services/installAttribution.test.ts src/services/billing/billing.test.ts
